personality_one_liner: A high-visibility, rugged sports command center designed for instant readability and effortless operation in direct sunlight.

spacing.rule: Generous hit targets, tight component spacing. Touch targets must be minimum 56pt, score targets much larger (100pt+).

dont's: No glassmorphism on the pitch. Pure contrast and solid surfaces for readability in direct sunlight.

screens.name: Home (E01)
screens.purpose: Launchpad for organizers to pick a game mode quickly or resume an ongoing session.

states.empty: N/A - Home is static mode choices.
states.error: Error toast if session restore fails.

screens.layout: Vertical ScrollView. Top header: App logo (Roundr) left aligned. Section 1 (Conditional): 'Reprendre la session' (Resume) card - brandPrimary background, huge impact. Section 2: 'Modes de jeu' (Game Modes) - 5 stacked cards (Classique, Maracana, Cup, Survie, Custom). Each card has a distinct icon (MaterialCommunityIcons), bold BarlowCondensed title, and a short Manrope description. Section 3 (Conditional): 'Mes chronos' (Custom presets) - horizontal scrolling list of pills or small cards. Bottom footer: subtle version/info text.

screens.name: Live Match (E03)
screens.purpose: The core timing and scorekeeping view, built for extreme visibility at 5 meters distance.
screens.layout: Top half: GIANT Chrono timer using BarlowCondensed_700Bold at size 140+. Fills 40-50% of the screen vertically. Middle: Two massive score buttons side by side (width 48%). Tapping anywhere in the box adds +1 score. Bottom: Next match/rotation preview and a large pause/menu button.

components.ModeCard: Stack layout, surfaceSecondary bg, 8px radius (md). Left side: large icon (MaterialCommunityIcons, brand color). Right side: Title (BarlowCondensed) and short description (Manrope muted text). Minimum height 80pt.
components.GiantChrono: Text component, color onSurface (white), tabular numbers (fontVariant: ['tabular-nums']), size 140+. Must be legible from meters away.
components.ScoreButton: Massive touch target (flex: 1 in a row). Background surfaceSecondary. Contains Team Name, massive Score number (BarlowCondensed), and a subtle '+1' watermark or icon. Active feedback is a background flash to brandTertiary and heavy haptic.
components.PrimaryButton: Height 60pt (extra large for dirty/wet hands). Background brandPrimary, Text onBrandPrimary. Radius md.
components.BottomSheet: Used for configuration and pause menus. Dark solid background (surfaceTertiary) with no blur.

pitch_background.alt: Aerial view of an illuminated amateur football pitch

carbon_texture.alt: Dark carbon fiber sports texture abstract

instructions_to_main_agent: The app MUST be in Dark Mode natively. Set the root background to '#000000'. Contrast is king.
Focus first on building E01 (Home Screen). Ensure the layout matches the 'layout' description: conditional resume card -> game mode cards -> custom presets.
Every interactive element (ModeCards, Buttons) must have a min-height of 56pt, ideally 60pt for better pitch-side usability.
Do NOT use glassmorphism. It reduces readability in direct sunlight. Stick to solid dark surfaces.
Use tabular-nums for any timers or changing digits to prevent horizontal jittering.
Implement haptics heavily. Adding a score or pressing play/pause on the timer should trigger `impactHeavy`.
Images provided (pitch_background, carbon_texture) can be used as subtle background textures (at 10-15% opacity) inside the Resume card or Header to give a sporty feel.
